Allowed: pure javascript html/css Not allowed: canvas frameworks (ajax, jquery etc) transparency effects > 8-bit images Solutions we thought about but did not test yet so we don't know how viable they are: Generate the full screen graphics in the backend and transfer to browser 10 times/second Generate the changed parts of the screen in the backend and transfer to browser up to 10 times/second (less bandwidth/image decoding than #1) We looked at CSS Animations but not sure they help since they have limited functionality.
